_note: Basic-tier accessibility. Shape: { [park_slug]: Omit<Accessibility, 'park_id' | 'updated_at'> & { sources: string[] } }. verified=true only when the park's official Experiences & Amenities / Accessible Amenities page describes the item; anything not stated is 'unknown' / null and `source` explains what the official page does and does not say. Same vocabulary as data/accessibility.json.

alfred-b-maclay-gardens-state-park.service_animals_note: Working service animals are welcome anywhere in the park, including the formal gardens.
alfred-b-maclay-gardens-state-park.source: Official park page states service animals are welcome anywhere; the Experiences & Amenities sub-page was not reachable (404) so water entry, restrooms and parking are unverified.

edward-ball-wakulla-springs-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: An amphibious mobility-assist vehicle (beach wheelchair) is available on request at the waterfront visitor center for getting to and into the water; a manual wheelchair can also be borrowed. Swim entry is otherwise from the grassy beach and the platform stairs. Shade from cypress trees along the beach.
edward-ball-wakulla-springs-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities, Swimming, Beach): manual wheelchair, amphibious mobility assist vehicle, wheelchair-friendly river boats, accessible picnic shelters and benches. Restroom accessibility and parking distance not stated.

falling-waters-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Entry is from a white sand beach into a small lake; the official page does not describe an accessible water entry.
falling-waters-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page: ADA-accessible restrooms at the lake and picnic area; pavilions near an accessible restroom. Sand beach entry from the Swimming section. Loaner chairs, parking distance and water access not stated.

florida-caverns-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Blue Hole swimming area is about 35 feet deep. The official page does not describe the water entry.
florida-caverns-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
florida-caverns-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page lists accessible visitor center/museum (with a video of the cave tour), gift shop and picnic facilities; it does not describe accessible water entry, restrooms or parking.

lake-louisa-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Swim entry is from the Lake Louisa beach; the official page does not describe an accessible water entry. A sidewalk connects the fully accessible playground to the beach bathhouse, and picnic tables sit under shade oaks.
lake-louisa-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of the park; tell staff on arrival at cabins.
lake-louisa-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page: fully accessible playground connected by sidewalk to the Lake Louisa bathhouse; accessible bathhouses and fishing piers in the campground and accessible pavilion at Dixie Lake. Whether the beach bathhouse restroom itself is accessible, ADA parking and water entry are not stated.

ponce-de-leon-springs-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: A chair lift at the spring lowers visitors into the water; call the park at 850-836-4281 ahead of your visit to arrange its use.
ponce-de-leon-springs-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
ponce-de-leon-springs-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities): chair lift at the spring (call ahead), restrooms with a spacious changing area, accessible picnic facilities. Parking distance and loaner wheelchairs not stated.

wes-skiles-peacock-springs-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: The official page does not describe the water entry. Facilities are limited: a portable restroom and changing room at each parking area, no potable water.
wes-skiles-peacock-springs-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
wes-skiles-peacock-springs-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page lists only accessible picnic facilities and interpretive exhibits; no accessible water entry, restroom or parking statement. Shade noted from the well-shaded trail and forest.

lake-manatee-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Swim entry is from a beach on the reservoir shore; the park says accessibility of the swimming area varies seasonally and asks visitors to call ahead. A rinse station is at the restroom by the swim area.
lake-manatee-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all visitor use areas of the park.
lake-manatee-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities): accessible parking, restrooms (ADA), playground, picnic facilities and campsites; swim-area access 'varies seasonally'. Loaner chairs, handrails and parking distance not stated.

mike-roess-gold-head-branch-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Large sandy beach downhill from the picnic area; the official page does not describe an accessible route or water entry. The restroom near the swim area has no electricity or showers.
mike-roess-gold-head-branch-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
mike-roess-gold-head-branch-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page lists only accessible picnic facilities, campsites and modern cabins; no accessible beach access, restroom, parking or loaner chair statement.

oscar-scherer-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: The park lists 'lake beach access' among its accessible amenities, plus an ADA-accessible pavilion (No. 4) at the Lake Osprey beach; the entry itself is a sandy beach. Beach bathhouse has cold-water showers.
oscar-scherer-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are allowed in all public areas and buildings of the park.
oscar-scherer-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities): lake beach access, accessible campsites and restrooms, Lester Finley Barrier Free Trail, Lake Osprey Trail, fishing dock, canoe/kayak launch, nature center, playground, tram tours, listening devices, captioned videos. ADA parking, loaner chairs and handrails not stated.

blackwater-river-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: A boardwalk runs from the pavilion parking lot to the restrooms, picnic area and main swimming beach; the park lists 'access to beach and river' and an outdoor shower among its accessible amenities. Entry into the water is from a sand beach on a river with current.
blackwater-river-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
blackwater-river-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities, Swimming): boardwalk from pavilion parking to restrooms/picnic area, access to beach and river, outdoor shower, accessible campsites and pavilion grills/tables. Beach wheelchair, ADA parking count and handrails not stated; call 850-983-5363.

ochlockonee-river-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: A beach wheelchair is available. Two of the four day-use pavilions are reached by paved sidewalks from the parking area, and there is an accessible outdoor shower at the Dead River pavilion. The water entry itself is not described.
ochlockonee-river-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities): beach wheelchair, accessible picnic pavilion, fishing/observation dock, boat ramp and dock, kayak launch, outdoor shower and water fountain, accessible campsites; paved sidewalks to two pavilions. Restroom accessibility and ADA parking not stated.

oleno-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: A beach wheelchair is available (ask at the ranger station). The swim area is a river bank on the Santa Fe; the official page does not describe the entry itself.
oleno-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities): beach wheelchair, accessible campsites, accessible cabin and dining hall in the group camp, ramp access to a picnic pavilion. Restrooms, parking and water entry not described.

henderson-beach-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: An all-terrain beach wheelchair is available at the ranger station for getting across the sand; entry into the Gulf is from a sand beach with surf. Boardwalks cross the dunes from the pavilions and parking to the beach.
henderson-beach-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
henderson-beach-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities, Beach, Parking): beach wheelchairs at the ranger station, 20 ADA parking spaces, accessible pavilions, benches, grills and campsites, beach boardwalks. Restroom accessibility not stated.

honeymoon-island-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Free beach wheelchairs at the ranger station; elevated boardwalks lead from parking to the main beach, where entry into the Gulf is over sand. Rinse showers are at the boardwalk heads.
honeymoon-island-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of the park.
honeymoon-island-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities, Restroom Facilities): free beach wheelchairs, elevated boardwalks to the beach, accessible parking and restrooms (several ADA; may close for cleaning), Limitless playground, nature center, concession, picnic facilities.

st-andrews-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Beach wheelchairs at the ranger station plus a motorised EcoRover beach wheelchair (reserve ahead on 850-708-6100). Elevated boardwalks lead to the beach and the jetty overlook; entry into the water is over sand, calmer on the lagoon side.
st-andrews-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
st-andrews-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities): EcoRover and standard beach wheelchairs, elevated boardwalks to beach and jetty overlook, restrooms with changing areas, two fishing piers, overlooks, accessible campsites and picnic facilities. ADA parking count and handrails not stated.

anastasia-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Elevated boardwalks and a Mobi-Mat lead across the sand to the beach; free beach wheelchairs from the Island Beach Shop and Grill or Anastasia Watersports. Entry into the surf is over sand.
anastasia-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
anastasia-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities, Beach, Playground): elevated boardwalks, Mobi-Mat, free beach wheelchairs, three accessible playgrounds, accessible campfire circle, picnic facilities. Day-use restroom accessibility and ADA parking count not stated.

bahia-honda-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: One free beach wheelchair, shared first-come, first-served. Entry to the water is over sand into very shallow water (4-6 ft further out); Sandspur Beach has parking right along the beach. Shade is limited.
bahia-honda-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of the park.
bahia-honda-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities, Restroom Facilities, Beach): free shared beach wheelchair, accessible parking, restrooms/bathhouses with accessible cold outdoor showers, accessible pavilion and grill at Calusa, accessible tour boats and campsites, Cabin 2 with wheelchair lift. Handrails and parking distance not stated.

grayton-beach-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Mobi-Mats run onto both the day-use beach and the cabin beach; a beach wheelchair is available if you call the park ahead (850-267-8300). Entry into the Gulf is over sand.
grayton-beach-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities, Beach): beach Mobi-Mats, beach wheelchair (call ahead), accessible cabins, campsites, pavilion and picnic table. Restrooms and ADA parking not stated.

caladesi-island-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Free beach wheelchairs at the ranger station; elevated boardwalks to the beach; entry into the Gulf over sand. Access to the island is by an accessible ferry from Honeymoon Island.
caladesi-island-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
caladesi-island-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities, Restroom Facilities): accessible ferry, elevated boardwalks, free beach wheelchairs, ADA restrooms, accessible picnic facilities and cafe; three ADA marina slips. No parking on the island.

fort-zachary-taylor-historic-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: Free beach wheelchairs - ask at the Cayo Hueso Cafe on the beach or the park office. The beach is sand and pebbles with a rocky bottom underfoot; shaded picnic area under the hammock trees.
fort-zachary-taylor-historic-state-park.service_animals_note: Service animals are welcome in all areas of Florida State Parks.
fort-zachary-taylor-historic-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities): free beach wheelchairs, accessible parking, restrooms, shower station, picnic facilities, ground-level fort areas and cafe. Handrails and parking-to-water distance not stated.

john-pennekamp-coral-reef-state-park.depth_at_entry_note: A beach wheelchair is available on request at the visitor center/aquarium building. Both beaches are small, human-made sand beaches; Far Beach has palm shade. The snorkel boat Encounter and glass-bottom boat Spirit of Pennekamp carry wheelchairs (tie-downs and a large marine restroom).
john-pennekamp-coral-reef-state-park.source: Official Experiences & Amenities page (Accessible Amenities): beach wheelchair at the visitor center, wheelchair-friendly glass-bottom and snorkel boats, accessible restrooms, pavilions, tables, benches and campsites, large-print literature and assisted listening devices; wheelchair-friendly rental dock. ADA parking count not stated.
